question: Wavel Ramkalawan, an Indian origin has been elected as the President of which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seychelles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• **Indian-origin Wavel Ramkalawan has been elected as the President of Seychelles. **

 
 
• Seychelles has elected an opposition candidate as president for the first time since 1977.
 
• He has defeated the incumbent Danny Faure.
 
• Ramakalwan is a priest of Indian Origin whose grandfather came from Gopalganj, Bihar.
 
• On October 25, 2020, India-born Wavel Ramkalawan was elected as the President of Seychelles.
 
• This is the first time, the opposition candidate has won elections in Seychelles since 1977
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__ 

 
• **​Seychelles Capital**: Victoria.
 
• **Seychelles Currency:** Seychellois rupee.
 
• **Seychelles Continent**: Africa.
 
• **Seychelles is an archipelago in the Indian Ocean. **
 
 
• It was a British colony till 1976. A year after its independence, in 1977 Mr. Faure seized power in a coup and retained the presidency in elections.
 
• He was in power till multi-party democracy was restored in the country in 1993.
